facts.fact: The terms of reference state that the National Data Centre in Area 4, Lilongwe (primary site) and the disaster-recovery site at Mandala, Blantyre are both Tier-III facilities; the main facility was expected to be fully operational in March 2025; the document is dated January 2025.
facts.system: National Data Centre and DR site

systems.system: National Data Centre, Lilongwe (primary) and Mandala Data Centre, Blantyre (DR site)

note: Disaster recovery planning and DR test reports are contracted future deliverables of the managed-services consultant, not a plan or test on record; the DR site is not stated to be in service.
